title: which lime should i trust? concepts, challenges, and solutions
core_idea: Provide a comprehensive survey of LIME by explaining its foundational concepts and known limitations (e.g., fidelity, stability, applicability), categorizing and comparing proposed adaptations and enhancements, and offering a structured taxonomy based on intermediate steps and key issues alongside an interactive overview website.
tldr: A concise survey that organizes LIME's core concepts, limitations, and numerous enhancements into a taxonomy to clarify available approaches and support researchers and practitioners.
